name: aspid-claude-plugins
description: Aspid marketplace for Claude Code — companion plugins for Aspid packages. Aspid.FastTools skills now ship in the Aspid.FastTools repository.

plugins.name: aspid-mvvm
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for the Aspid.MVVM Unity package (tech.aspid.mvvm). Helps Claude Code generate correct ViewModel classes, data bindings, and relay commands in projects that consume the package.

plugins.name: aspid-collections
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for the Aspid.Collections Unity package (tech.aspid.collections). Helps Claude Code generate correct observable collection usage with proper ownership, event handling, and synchronization patterns.

plugins.name: aspid-unity-package
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for creating Unity packages following Aspid conventions — UPM samples with EN/RU README pairs, assembly definitions with correct references, and standard package structure.
